test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Two statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All papers are trees.

Some papers are leaves.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some trees are leaves.

II. Some trees are papers.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e5293d7c27378767bc6662e8d8836aa45ae7d775f31ff234c1a8de9a3be1500c.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some trees are leaves - **TRUE **(Because some paper are leaves and all paper are tree, so some trees are leaf is definitely true)

II. Some trees are papers - **TRUE **(Because all paper are tree, so some tree is paper is also true).

So, **Both conclusion I and II follows**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
